# Vendored Hermes Ultra

Repository: https://github.com/sheawinkler/hermes-agent-ultra

Revision: `c002f8c4efe475c89c9f14d3995d44e6a5df5b27`

Only Rust workspace sources and required build resources are distributed here.
The application links the agent, core, authentication, intelligence and skills
crates. CLI/TUI, gateways and unused messaging integrations are not initialized.

Application changes are recorded in `patches/README.md`. Preserve this revision,
the upstream license, and inherited third-party notices when updating the source.
